name: Jaiprakash Power Ventures Limited
remarksWeb: A.   Pursuant to the Debt Resolution Plan, the Company had signed a Framework Agreement (the Agreement) with the Banks and Financial Institutions for restructuring of the outstanding Loans and Interest thereon.  In terms of the Agreement and as agreed upon, the Company has allotted Unlisted Fully paid up 0.01% Cumulative Compulsory Convertible Preference Shares (CCPS) for an aggregate amount of Rs.3,80,553 lakhs to its lenders on private placement basis upon conversion of Debt. The CCPs have maturity of 29 years and shall be converted into such number of Equity Shares as may be determined at the time of conversion as per prevailing provision of Companies Act/SEBI/RBI Rules and Regulations. In the absence of determinability of number of equity shares to be issued upon conversion of CCPS, the equity capital on diluted basis is shown Zero.  B.   Jaiprakash Power Ventures Limited (JPVL) was incorporated in the year 1994 as a Public Limited Company. At the time of incorporation, to ensure minimum distribution of shareholding i.e. 7 (seven) members in case of a Public Limited Company, the following six persons stood as subscribers to the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Company along with Promoter, erstwhile Jaiprakash Industries Ltd. now Jaiprakash Associates Limited (JAL); 1.   Shri Satyendra Prakash Joshi (Late)  2.   Shri Jaiprakash Gaur  3.   Shri Nanak Chand Sharma  4.   Shri Shyam Datt Nailwal  5.   Shri Harish K Vaid  6.   Shri Sarat Kumar Jain (Late)   The above mentioned 6 (six) persons were holding 300 shares each aggregating to 1800 shares jointly with Promoter  JAL (the beneficial interest of which was with JAL) till March 2021. Please note that they were not holding any equity share in the personal capacity but jointly with the Promoter of the Company. These shares are now held by JAL instead of the same being held in joint name as it is a public listed company now. It is also important to mention that their name was not shown in the Prospectus filed at the time of Public Issue as part of the Promoter or Promoter Group.   C.   The shares pledged by Promoters comprise of 120,05,09,431 Shares pledged and 10,21,88,566 Shares put under Non Disposal Undertaking (NDU).  D. Jaypee Infra Ventures Private Limited is a promoter group company holding NIL shares.
